Attach All mediationverse Packages

Source: R/attach-all.R
mediationverse_attach_all.Rd

library(mediationverse) attaches only medfit (selective loading). This attaches every installed core member in one call, which suits teaching and scripts that use the whole ecosystem.

Usage

mediationverse_attach_all()

Value

Invisibly, a named character vector with one status per core package: "attached", "already attached", "not installed" or "failed to load". A package that cannot be attached never aborts the call.

Details

Attaching several packages can mask functions. Run mediationverse_conflicts() afterwards to see which.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
mediationverse_attach_all()
} # }
